parameters.name: UploadFileMaxSize
parameters.description: The maximum size of a single virus file that can be uploaded. Unit: KB. Valid values: 0 to 204800. A value of 0 indicates no size limit. Values from 1 to 204800 specify the actual size limit.

parameters.name: UploadFileMaxSpeed
parameters.description: The maximum upload rate for virus files. Unit: KB/s. Valid values: 0 to 102400. A value of 0 indicates no rate limit.

parameters.name: UploadFileSuffixBlacklist
parameters.description: The collection of file types that are prohibited from being uploaded. Duplicate values are not allowed. Files that match the specified types are not uploaded even if upload is enabled.

parameters.name: VirusFileUpload
parameters.description:
Specifies whether user terminal devices are allowed to upload detected virus files to the cloud for further analysis. Valid values:
- **true**: Allowed.
- **false**: Not allowed.
